text:
Claire: Drafting a one-page field brief for enterprise launch — focus: deployment modes + security + an easy bench stat. Aim: single email attachment for AEs. Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/enterprise-quick-brief-v3

Omar: Nice. Structure suggestion: top one-liner outcome, 3 security badges, micro-benchmark card, routing + copy-paste play snippet, CTA to gated deck. Keep it printable.

Ellen: Bench owner here. Latest controlled run (2026-04-18): text-gen-3 @512 tokens p95 = 62ms on Dedicated; median cost per 1k tokens = $0.39. We compared a self-host sample at ~$0.67/k. Callout: ~42% lower unit cost vs typical self-host. I'll upload CSV + methodology to Drive.

Vik: Perfect — include a one-line ops note about graceful fallback (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and model-variant fallbacks for capacity-constrained situations. Field wants copy-paste code.

Claire: Good call. Also want a short webinar (20m) to coincide with the brief — demo routing + KMS setup + audit logs. Proposed date May 5. Who can own bench slide + demo infra?

Ellen: I'll own bench slide and appendix. Will include p95 graph and a small note on test setup (steady-state 10k reqs, mixed prompt lengths, cold-start excluded). Drive link: https://redwood.app/drive/enterprise-briefs/bench-04-18.csv

Vik: I'll take demo infra + scripted failover. I'll prepare a 7-min runbook showing Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private switch and a model-variant fallback to a quantized variant.

Omar: For field playbook, pasteable inbound routing snippet (short):

```
# inbound routing (pasteable)
if customer.needs_isolation or customer.data_residency == 'on-prem':
    route = 'private-vpc'
elif customer.commitment_monthly >= 35000 or customer.latency_sla == 'p95<=80ms':
    route = 'dedicated-reservation'
else:
    route = 'hosted-api'
```

Claire: Nice and concise. For headline A/B on landing page, let's test: Variant A = "Stable SLAs for enterprise inference" vs Variant B = "Private, cost-efficient LLM serving". Track CTR and gated-download conversions.

Ellen: Adding FAQ bullets: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, HIPAA (as needed), KMS/HSM integrations, audit log exports, and retention windows. Will include contact for compliance pack.

AssetBot: Landing template generated: https://redwood.app/landing/enterprise-deploy-brief. I can schedule the announcement for May 5 09:00 PT if assets are final by May 1 EOD.

Claire: Deliverables and owners: Claire = one-pager copy & layout; Ellen = bench slide + CSV + appendix; Vik = demo infra + failover script; Omar = A/B headline setup + playbook snippet; AssetBot = landing + scheduling. I'll post the PDF draft here for review by Apr 30. Thanks! :rocket:
